notes: Seed use cases from the owner's live products. A use case is a job, its constraints, and its success criteria. Recommendations and evaluations land in Phase 1.

use_cases.name: Indonesian ↔ English translation
use_cases.summary: Translate school content between Indonesian and English while preserving names, glossary terms, and formatting.
success_criteria: Masked names survive 10/10 in both directions
Quality stays at or above the previous primary
A 300-segment entry fits a five-minute cron budget
The licence permits the deployment

use_cases.name: Offline speech transcription
use_cases.summary: Transcribe Indonesian and English recordings on a laptop, with timestamps, without sending audio to a provider.
success_criteria: Word error rate is acceptable on real recordings
Timestamps align with the audio
The model runs offline in the memory budget
The licence permits the use

use_cases.name: On-device speech synthesis
use_cases.summary: Render natural word and sentence audio on an Apple-Silicon laptop for a local-first learning app.
success_criteria: A human listener prefers the voice for the app
Audio is at least 22 kHz and mp3-friendly
One-word clips sound natural
The engine runs offline without a GPU

use_cases.name: On-device topic tagging
use_cases.summary: Suggest and apply topic tags to Indonesian and English content inside an admin browser, without a server call.
success_criteria: The model classifies Indonesian and English content
Suggestions are useful enough for an editor to accept
The model loads lazily in the browser
The licence and device cap fit the site

use_cases.name: Student report generation
use_cases.summary: Generate an Indonesian kindergarten report from teacher notes, with a source link for every step and no invented evidence.
success_criteria: Every mark and note cites a teacher update
The model never invents evidence or attendance
A teacher can review and correct the result
Child note text is not used for training

use_cases.name: Coding agent
use_cases.summary: Use a model that calls tools reliably in a coding agent, within a local or hosted memory budget.
success_criteria: Tool calls are accurate and recover from errors
The model completes repository tasks, not only snippets
The context window fits the task
The licence permits the use
